summary: **Shri Gireesh. B. Pradhan, Chairperson Shri A.S. Bakshi, Member Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member** Approval of generation tariff of Chutak Power Station (4x11MW) for the period 2014-19. NHPC Ltd NHPC Office Complex, Sector-33 Faridabad-121003 Haryana **...Petitioner** The petitioner, NHPC, has filed this petition for approval of generation tariff in respect Commission vide order dated 29.3.2017 in Petition No. 252/GT/2014 had approved the tariff of Chutak Power Station (4x11MW) for the period 2014-19.as under: _Order in Petition No. 252/GT/2014 (Corrigendum) Page 1 of 6_ 2. It is observed that certain arithmetical / clerical error had crept in the Order dated 29.3.2017 as regards the calculation of normative IDC, to the effect that the normative IDC of ₹4965.00 lakh was inadvertently considered as ₹50.00 lakh. This error has been rectified and the normative IDC of ₹4965.00 lakh has been considered. Based on this, the completion cost of the said project works out to ₹94206.00 lakh (89376 lakh + 4965 lakh - 135 lakh) instead of ₹89425.65 lakh as considered in order dated 29.3.2017. Based on the completion cost of ₹94206.00 lakh, the projected additional capital expenditure which has been restricted to ₹2560.19 lakh in order dated 29.3.2017 has been rectified as ₹7124.42 lakh including discharge of liabilities and allowed in exercise of Power under Regulation 103A of the CERC (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 and the annual fixed charges as determined in order dated 29.3.2017 is modified and stated in the subsequent paragraphs. 3.
